DIAMETER::respond
Description
This iRules command sends message to client on clientside or server on
serverside.
Syntax
DIAMETER
::
respond
"version"
"r"
"p"
"e"
"t"
"comcode"
"appid"
"hopid"
"endid"
"AVPs"
Note
: AVPs is binary data containing all attribute value pairs.
